parts.text:
{
  "conversations": [
    {
      "title": "Rent a surfboard",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I need to rent a surfboard." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "What size do you want?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I'd like a mid-length board, please." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I'll take a longboard, please.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "How many days?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Just for today." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "For three days, please.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "That's twenty dollars." }
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Ask about wave conditions",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "How are the waves today?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "They're pretty big right now." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "They're small and clean.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Where's the best spot for intermediates?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the point break down the beach." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Stay near the river mouth.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Thanks for the tip." }
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Get local food recommendations",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Where's a good place to eat nearby?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the soda on the main road." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "What's the best dish here?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Get the fish casado." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "The chicken rice is really good.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Is it close by?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "It's a five-minute walk." }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "vocab": [
    "board",
    "size",
    "day",
    "waves",
    "spot",
    "beach",
    "food",
    "road",
    "fish",
    "rent",
    "want",
    "big",
    "small",
    "close"
  ]
}
